  "hypotheses": [
    {
      "explanation":"stolen_card",
      "likelihood":"high",
      "reasoning":"The issuing-country/IP mismatch combined with failed CVV triggers the Card condition. The failed identity and issuer-authentication check substantially strengthens the unauthorized-payment explanation."
    },
    {
      "explanation":"legitimate_customer",
      "likelihood":"low",
      "reasoning":"An established device and home delivery support a legitimate customer using a foreign-issued card and entering an incorrect CVV. However, the completed verification failed, so this benign explanation does not permit clearance."
    }

  "disposition":"decline",
  "citations":["R03","FP-2 §6.3","FP-2 §6.4","FP-2 §6.6(b)","FP-2 §5.2","FP-2 §5.3(b)","FP-2 §4.2"],
  "next_check":"none",
  "memo":"R03 holds: issuing-country/IP mismatch and failed CVV establish the Card family. No Account access, Velocity or Linkage condition holds; household exceptions are unnecessary. No earlier outcome settles the order. The applicable review row is §6.6(b), but the failed required id_check now decides it under §5.3(b): decline is standard, and escalation is prohibited without Linkage. Familiar-device use and home delivery support a benign foreign-card explanation, but cannot override the failed check. The order has already shipped, so decline cannot prevent its loss; it blocks the account. No further check is needed."
